confirmed.match: Two player teams in a combined ground/air battle; both field ground and air AI
confirmed.setting: Fictional conflicts on real geography; era-separated aircraft rooms
confirmed.reset: Front line resets after each match
confirmed.geographic_scale: 1:1; select a suitable real-world subregion instead of compressing distances
confirmed.player_role: Aircraft assisting an actual AI ground front and fighting for air superiority
hud: Gun ammunition in upper-left flight data
confirmed.frontline: Multiple simultaneous sectors and advancing ground forces
confirmed.victory: Advance through key sectors and reduce opposing readiness; air combat and logistics strikes contribute
confirmed.air_defense: Front-line guns and short-range air defence; era-appropriate radar air defence protects rear objectives
confirmed.airport_siting: Real airports primarily; campaign extensions and a small number of fictional forward airfields allowed
confirmed.team_aircraft_pool: Both teams share the era-restricted aircraft pool, distinguished by team identity
confirmed.enemy_intelligence: Discovery or sensors required; team sharing; stale mobile-target contacts retain last known position instead of revealing current truth
player_roles: Directly drive a tank and command an AI tank company during ground attacks
Fly aircraft for air superiority and ground support
confirmed.airfield_logistics: Light logistics: facilities and transport affect supply availability; no per-round ammunition ledger for airfield stock
confirmed.bridges: Destructible; engineers can repair or construct temporary crossings; forces may seek detours
confirmed.runway_recovery: Damaged regions close temporarily; engineers repair them; escorted supply can accelerate recovery

tank_company.commandStyle: Direct driving of the command tank; map orders for movement, attack and defence
tank_company.afterCommandTankLoss: After loss of the controlled tank, the player may take over an owned surviving AI tank; preserve its position, ammunition, damage and vehicle life.
tank_company.whileOwnerFlies: AI continues the last accepted company task while its owner flies; the company remains owned by that player.
tank_company.replacements: Missing company members are replenished in batches at a friendly deployment source. Reinforcement vehicles physically follow a valid route to rejoin; no instant frontline refill.
tank_company.ordersWhileFlying: While flying, the owner can issue simplified move/attack/defend map orders to the same company, while directly controlling only one vehicle.

confirmed.role_switch: Return to a friendly deployment area, or lose the current vehicle, then select a tank company or aircraft sortie

friendly_fire.meaning: Friendly units remain physical obstacles and ballistic contacts; disabling friendly damage must not make them transparent.

confirmed.taiwan_coverage: Entire Taiwan main island, with retained mainland coast/Penghu/Kinmen/Matsu geography;1:1. This supersedes the partial-main-island extent options.
